error.name: Bad Request
error.description:
The request parameters are invalid or missing.
                        
Usage:

https://affiliate.linkwi.se/api/1.1/reports_transaction.html?<parameter_name>=<parameter_value>

Required parameters:

fields  comma separated list of the fields appearing in the report. These may be:
        program_id, program, program_cat, rotator, creative, subid1, subid2,
        subid3, subid4, subid5, transaction_id, type, status, subaction, 
        amended, amount, commission, click_date, transaction_date, status_date, 
        click_ref_url, payout_cat, payment_status.
        This is the only required parameter.

length     may contain any one of the following values:
           last_2_minutes, today, yesterday, last_7_days, this_week, last_week, this_month,
           last_month, this_year, last_year, custom

Optional parameters:

format     Can be either xml or json
        
from       If length is set to custom, from specifies the start date of the requested
           date period. Its value is of the format 31/12/2010

from_time  If length is set to custom, from_time specifies the start time of the requested
           date period. Its value is of the format 00:00:00

to         If length is set to custom, to specifies the end date of the requested
           date period. Its value is of the format 31/12/2010

to_time    If length is set to custom, to_time specifies the end time of the requested
           date period. Its value is of the format 23:59:59

status     filter the transactions based on their status. Values can be:
           "pending", "validated", "cancelled" and "pending_validated"

based_on    Set to "status" for the date limits to apply to status dates
            otherwise set to "transaction" for the date limits to apply to
            the transaction dates.

programs    You can limit the programs appearing in the report by specifying
            the program names with this parameter, separated with commas.
            
program_ids You can limit the programs appearing in the report by specifying
            the program ids with this parameter, separated with commas.
            
program_category_ids    Limits the programs in the report to the ones belonging to the
                        specified category ID.
              
search_field    This allows you to create a custom filter. search_field can take
search_value    any of the following values: "transaction_id", "subid1",
                "subid2", "subid3", "subid4", "subid5", "click_ref_url".
                If you specify both search_field and search_value, the
                report will only show transactions where the specified field
                value is equal to the one contained in search_value.
    
sort_by         Can be one value from "fields" parameter.

sort_by_order   Can be "asc" or "desc". If set "sort_by" must be also set. 
                
Example: https://affiliate.linkwi.se/api/1.1/reports_transaction.html?fields=program,creative&length=this_month

Global options:

timezone    Can be either "UTC" (the default) or "Europe/Athens"

rest_date_format    All dates use the ISO 8601 format by default
                    (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601). You can change this
                    by setting this option to "timestamp".

rest_json_force_object  If you use the JSON format, set this option to "on" to
                        force the response to be enclosed into an object.

rest_jsonp_callback   If you use the JSON format, set this option to callback function's name to
                      force the response to be enclosed into a function call. It must be a valid
                      function name.
